summary: The Hostex setup URL is plain https://api.hostex.io/v3; the spec's auth description carries a stray trailing backtick that a regen copies into auth setup, doctor, MCP metadata and the manifests.
reason: The official spec's securityScheme description ends the URL with a backtick, so the generated setup URL is not openable; auth set-token also reads the token from stdin, so docs must show a pipe.
validated_outcome: grep finds no 'v3`' in the source tree; auth setup prints https://api.hostex.io/v3.
